description: Source code implementing routing and socket communication for message handling in a networked system, including functions for binding listeners, accepting client connections, sending messages, and message dispatching.

methods.name: rtRouteBase_CloseListener
methods.description: Closes a listener socket, shutting down and closing the file descriptor.

methods.name: rtRouteBase_BindListener
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket listener to a specified address, with options for no delay and retries.

methods.name: _rtdirect_send_reply_to_client
methods.description: Sends a reply message to a connected client using the provided message header and response data.

methods.name: _rtdirect_prepare_reply_from_request
methods.description: Prepares a reply message header based on an incoming request message header.

methods.name: _rtdirect_OnMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processing subscription requests or dispatching to registered handlers.

methods.name: _rtdirect_pushFd
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to an fd_set for select, updating maxFd.

methods.name: _rtdirect_dispatch_message_from_client
methods.description: Dispatches a received message from a client to the appropriate route handler.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Init
methods.description: Initializes a connected client structure with socket and endpoint info.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Reset
methods.description: Resets the client connection state to read a new message.

methods.name: rtConnectedClient_Read
methods.description: Reads and processes incoming data from a client socket, handling message framing and dispatch.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_RegisterNewClient
methods.description: Registers a new client connection upon acceptance.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_AcceptClientConnection
methods.description: Accepts an incoming client connection on a listener socket.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a client with a constructed message header.

methods.name: rtRouteDirect_StartInstance
methods.description: Starts the direct routing instance, setting up socket listener and handling client connections in a loop.
